bukhari:5678.text: The Prophet ﷺ said: “There is no disease that Allah has created, except that He also has created its treatment.”

muslim:2204.text: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “There is a remedy for every malady, and when the remedy is applied to the disease it is cured with the permission of Allah, the Exalted and Glorious.”

muslim:2699.text: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “…He who treads the path in search of knowledge, Allah would make that path easy, leading to Paradise for him…”

ibnmajah:224.text: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Seeking knowledge is a duty upon every Muslim.”
ibnmajah:224.note: This particular chain is weak, but the sentence quoted here is graded authentic because it is reported through many other routes. The remainder of the narration in this chain is not accepted, so we do not quote it.

abudawud:3641.text: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “If anyone travels on a road in search of knowledge, Allah will cause him to travel on one of the roads of Paradise… The superiority of the learned man over the devout is like that of the moon, on the night when it is full, over the rest of the stars. The learned are the heirs of the Prophets, and the Prophets leave neither dinar nor dirham, leaving only knowledge, and he who takes it takes an abundant portion.”

abudawud:3664.text: The Prophet ﷺ said: “If anyone acquires knowledge that should be sought seeking the Face of Allah, but he acquires it only to get some worldly advantage, he will not experience the fragrance of Paradise.”

muslim:1905.text: …Then will be brought forward a man who acquired knowledge and imparted it and recited the Qur’an… He will say: “I acquired knowledge and disseminated it and recited the Qur’an seeking Your pleasure.” Allah will say: “You have told a lie. You acquired knowledge so that you might be called ‘a scholar’…”
muslim:1905.note: Part of a longer hadith describing three people whose outwardly good deeds were done for fame rather than for God.

muslim:1631.text: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “When a man dies, his acts come to an end, but three: recurring charity, or knowledge by which people benefit, or a pious child who prays for him.”

ibnmajah:925.text: When the Prophet ﷺ prayed the morning prayer, after the salām he would say: “O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, goodly provision and acceptable deeds.”

muslim:2722.text: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to supplicate: “…O Allah, I seek refuge in You from knowledge which does not benefit, from a heart that does not fear You, from a soul that is not satisfied, and from a supplication that is not answered.”

bukhari:1043.text: The sun eclipsed in the lifetime of Allah’s Messenger ﷺ on the day when his son Ibrāhīm died, and the people said that the sun had eclipsed because of the death of Ibrāhīm. Allah’s Messenger ﷺ said: “The sun and the moon do not eclipse because of the death or life of someone. When you see the eclipse, pray and invoke Allah.”

bukhari:846.text: After a rainy night the Prophet ﷺ said: “Allah has said: ‘…Whoever said that the rain was due to the blessings and the mercy of Allah had belief in Me and disbelieves in the stars; and whoever said that it rained because of a particular star had no belief in Me but believes in that star.’”

bukhari:3199.text: The Prophet ﷺ asked me at sunset: “Do you know where the sun goes?” I replied: “Allah and His Messenger know better.” He said: “It goes till it prostrates itself underneath the Throne and takes permission to rise again, and it is permitted… And that is the meaning of the statement of Allah: ‘And the sun moves towards its final point; this is the command of the Almighty, the All-Knowing’ (36:38).”

bukhari:3208.text: Allah’s Messenger ﷺ, the truthful and truly inspired, said: “The creation of each one of you is gathered together in his mother’s womb for forty days, then he becomes an ʿalaqah for a similar period, then a muḍghah for a similar period. Then Allah sends an angel…”
bukhari:3208.note: The same hadith is in Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim 2643.

muslim:2645.text: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “When forty-two nights have passed over the drop (nuṭfah), Allah sends an angel to it, who shapes it and creates its hearing, its sight, its skin, its flesh and its bones. Then he says: ‘My Lord, is it male or female?’ And your Lord decides as He wills…”

bukhari:5728.text: The Prophet ﷺ said: “If you hear of an outbreak of plague in a land, do not enter it; but if the plague breaks out in a place while you are in it, do not leave that place.”

tirmidhi:2517.text: A man said: “O Messenger of Allah, shall I tie it (my camel) and rely upon Allah, or leave it loose and rely upon Allah?” He said: “Tie it and rely upon Allah.”

bukhari:5688.text: I heard Allah’s Messenger ﷺ saying: “There is healing in black cumin (al-ḥabbat al-sawdāʾ) for all diseases except death.”

bukhari:3868.text: The people of Makkah asked Allah’s Messenger ﷺ to show them a miracle. So he showed them the moon split in two halves, between which they saw the mountain of Ḥirāʾ.

bukhari:71.text: I heard Allah’s Messenger ﷺ saying: “If Allah wants to do good to a person, He gives him understanding of the religion. I am only a distributor, and it is Allah who gives…”

bukhari:887.text: Allah’s Messenger ﷺ said: “If I had not found it hard for my followers, I would have ordered them to clean their teeth with the siwāk for every prayer.”

muslim:223.text: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Cleanliness is half of faith…”

tirmidhi:2380.text: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying: “The human does not fill any container that is worse than his stomach. It is sufficient for the son of Adam to eat what will support his back. If this is not possible, then a third for food, a third for drink, and a third for his breath.”
